d:
Aasan hai karna pradhanmantri ki aalochna
Mukhyamantri ki karna usse thora mushkil
Vidhayak ki aalochna men khatra zarur hai
Lekin gram pradhan ke mamle men to pitaee hona tay hai.
Amezan ke varsha vanon ki chinta karna kul hai
Himalay ke gleshiyron par bahas khari karna
Thora mehnat ka kam
Bare pavar plant ka virodh karna
